records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli
evidence: host:a new Claude Code CLI session loaded the installed spec-guard:ticket skill
result:the installed plugin reported version 0.19.0 and remained enabled

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-ticket
evidence: host:the new CLI session invoked /spec-guard:ticket with Skill permission and only the read-only issue-list tool allowed
result:the skill called epiq_issue_list with brief=true and includeClosed=false and returned the existing open ticket also observed by Codex Desktop
result:no ticket or repository write was requested; creation, editing, closing, and cross-project messaging were not tested

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-ticket-cross-host-read
evidence: scope:a new Claude Code CLI session opened the same no-origin temporary repository used by Codex Desktop
host:the session loaded /spec-guard:ticket and called epiq_issue_list and epiq_issue_get for a temporary test ticket
result:before closure it read the Codex Desktop comment; after closure a fresh CLI session called epiq_issue_get and observed isClosed=true
limit:an initial untraced natural-language response did not establish a successful read; only the later traced tool calls count as verification
limit:Claude Code CLI ticket writes and cross-project collaboration messaging were not tested

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-ticket-write
evidence: scope:new Claude Code CLI sessions used the initialized no-origin temporary repository and did not touch the existing project ledger
host:the sessions loaded /spec-guard:ticket and called epiq_issue_create, epiq_issue_comment_add, and epiq_issue_close
result:a temporary test ticket was created, commented on, and closed; Codex Desktop read the comment and isClosed=true
limit:the installed v0.19.0 skill passed a short ref directly to epiq_issue_comment_add, which returned Issue not found; the successful comment and close used the full issue ID
limit:cross-project collaboration messaging was not tested
